name: Reign Fall
desc:
Reign Fall is a chaotic zombie co-op shooter where up to 4 players fight through hordes of infected to save Kovrovka

FEATURES
Campaign & Survival
Weapon Gunsmith
Skills, Utilities & Gear
Character Customization
Playable on PC, Console, Mobile
Customizable Settings & Controls

⚠️ Token Shop contents are subject to changes or removal at any point
⚠️ Exploiting = Permanent ban
⚠️ Bypassed Weapon Names = Temporary Ban + Wipe
